image_query: Vasco da Gama before the Zamorin of Calicut painting Veloso Salgado
tweets: Vasco da Gama before the Zamorin of Calicut, by José Veloso Salgado (1898). On 29 August 1498, laden with Malabar pepper and cinnamon, Gama's ships turned for Portugal — the first direct sea voyage linking Europe to India, opened at this Kerala court.
